gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-kharosht: Press Start 2P spaces its letters like cut-outs pinned far apart, with only a faint modulation you notice up close. But Noto Sans Kharoshthi takes over with open-ended curves and a dark, dense lowercase that settles the page.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Noto Sans Khmer brings generous notch-like openings and near-capital small letters beneath the retro display of Press Start 2P. Playful retro up top, clean modern text below: that split is the appeal.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-lao: Press Start 2P looks like cut-out letters pinned far apart. Noto Sans Lao then lifts its x-height high and keeps its mouths open, so paragraph after paragraph goes down smoothly.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Noto Sans Limbu has tall-bodied small letters and gaping curves, set against the moderate contrast of Press Start 2P. And text in it moves along smoothly, with plenty of light inside each shape.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-lisu: Press Start 2P has a small, steady difference in stroke thickness and wide-spaced, cut-out-style letters. Noto Sans Lisu has sweeping s curves, and bumping its size up a notch gives the tiny ascender gaps room.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-lydian: Retro fun, in Press Start 2P: big lowercase bowls with a mild pen-like weight shift. Noto Sans Lydian keeps its capitals barely taller than lowercase and its openings wide, so reading goes down easily.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-mahajani: Retro fun, with gentle modulation and big lowercase bowls. Press Start 2P pins its letters far apart, while Noto Sans Mahajani stands tall with a funnel-wide e to keep things grounded.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-mayan-nu: Playful retro lettering, with each letter pinned far from the next. Press Start 2P handles the heading, while Noto Sans Mayan Numerals, with its tall, gaping lowercase, can be sized up slightly.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-medefaid: Fun and retro, Press Start 2P adds a hint of wedge pressure in each curve. Noto Sans Medefaidrin rises high in the lowercase and keeps ink from pooling in its curves, so the text stays crisp beneath.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-meetei-m: Fun first: Press Start 2P pins its letters far apart. It brings the retro spark, while Noto Sans Meetei Mayek, with large lowercase eyes and rounds that gap like a cracked bangle, handles the quiet modern reading.
